results.name: Settings save a custom anticipation, reference time and opening-reminder toggle
Preview shows the new UI without consuming actual task reminders
Got it dismisses that schedule across reload while retaining the unfinished task
Changing the due date creates a fresh reminder
Snoozed reminder returns after the stored waiting period ends
Open task switches to its correct workspace and preserves reference photos
Completing a repeating task from the reminder creates one successor
Explicit reminder time overrides an overdue due date; completed tasks are excluded
Opening reminders can be disabled without erasing task dates
Deep links open the requested task without an interrupting reminder
Reminder claims are atomic across tabs, expire after a closed tab and stay out of backups
Reminder window fits small screens and uses a dark backdrop without blur
